messages:
sara: spotting a weird placement pattern: nodes show 2 free GPUs each but scheduler can't fit any new gpu:1 pods, pending ~48
ben: I think topology-aware volume-affinity + GPU topology scoring is rejecting placements because pods require nvlink-locality and PVs are zone-bound
omar: logs: `scheduler: pod=ml-train-xyz score=0 node=node-17 reason=nvlink_mismatch; pv-affinity=node-17b`
sre-bot: ALERT: cluster=eu-west1 condition=packing_efficiency<0.5 pending_gpu>40
iris: repro: lots of small pods with `topologyHint: "nvlink-local"` and dynamic PVCs bound to different AZ subpaths; together they fragment allocation across sibling GPUs
sara: quick fix: relax topologyConstraint for tiny pods so they accept any nvlink-compatible group, and run a consolidation job to coalesce small pods
ben: patched scheduler-configmap: `kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -n infra -p '{"data":{"nvlink_strict":"false"}}'`
omar: kicked off consolidation: `./tools/consolidate-pods --selector=app=tiny-gpu --region=eu-west1 --apply` moved 38 pods and freed ~32 GPUs
sre-bot: NOTE: set autoscaler.freeze=true to avoid immediate scale-down during consolidation
iris: after consolidation packing_efficiency -> 0.81, pending dropped to 7, preempt churn decreased
sara: follow-ups: add e2e test for pv+nvlink combos, add metric `nvlink_placement_failures_total`, and add runbook entry for `consolidate-pods` tool
ben: also consider turning on PV co-location hints in provisioner so PVCs favor nodes with matching GPU topology
omar: opening PRs: scheduler config docs, provisioner PV affinity tweaks, and a postmortem in #incidents. tagging @sre-oncall if it spikes again
sara: thanks—leaving config relax in place for 2h then reverting after watching for regressions
